slices.title: Multirotor design, simulation and evidence loop

tasks.title: Record the completed standalone desktop qualification
tasks.acceptance: Keep the measured qualification PASS, source SHAs, failures and scope intact; no repeat qualification prerequisite for normal execution.

tasks.title: Preserve contracts, archive and development-evidence baseline
tasks.acceptance: Contract export matches the existing lock; all 21 WIP paths remain traceable; all 20 inspected campaigns remain DEVELOPMENT; no physical gate promoted.

tasks.title: Deliver the master checklist, workspace migration and GitHub task sync
tasks.acceptance: All development work is under the requested workspace; 208 moved source files retain their hashes; generated plan validates and all 17 issue checklists match its digest.

tasks.title: Record owner authorization for the planning lock
tasks.acceptance: Actual owner authorization to merge/tag after the three pre-merge checks and green CI is recorded. Approval is distinct from the later operations: merge/tag/clean-main proof belongs to the PR conversation and Git refs after execution, never fabricated before merge. This request does not authorize P0A-005.

tasks.title: Reproduce and freeze M21 cutoff regression cases
tasks.acceptance: Reproduce the SIT 63/63 replay and 68/68 forecast missed 80 V study crossings using pinned DEVELOPMENT data; publish exact commands, time/event definitions and failing regressions before changes.
todos: 1. DONE — pinned DEVELOPMENT campaign rows, hashes and clock/time definitions read from docs/M21_BATTERY_CAMPAIGN.md, docs/campaigns/M21_6_10_SIT_MODULE_ELECTROTHERMAL.md, docs/campaigns/M21_11_15_SIT_CUTOFF_FORECAST.md and data/research/registry.json.
2. DONE — tests/acceptance/test_p0a_005.py reproduces 63/63 replay and 68/68 forecast missed 80 V crossings from the pinned workbook (full re-execution bit-identical).
3. DONE — exact commands, time/event definitions and failing regressions published in docs/acceptance/P0A-005.md with the pinned hashes.
4. DONE — packages/physics untouched; the causal fixes are P0A-006.
5. DONE — verification commands run and output recorded in docs/acceptance/P0A-005.md.

tasks.title: Correct causal battery sag and cutoff event propagation
tasks.acceptance: Supported current, SOC, bus-voltage and cutoff events affect the authoritative plant and FAIL verdict; event bracketing handles equality and timestep boundaries; no future measured input or threshold tuning to confirmatory outcomes.
todos: 1. battery.py: strict declared OCV support (fail closed below the calibrated knee region, no extrapolation), exact quadratic constant-power solve of V_bus = V_oc(SOC) - V_rc - I*R_int with voltage-collapse detection (stable upper root), max deliverable power, and deterministic sub-step cutoff/warning crossing bracketing. Existing method semantics stay byte-identical (the frozen SIT benchmarks call them).

2. Authoritative plant (verified: Godot -> scripts/lab_project.py run -> project_service.run_project -> simulation_service.run_simulation -> scenarios.service.run_flight -> runner.run_scenario -> LoopPowertrain.step; packages/desktop_worker/engine.py is the CAD engine, not the flight plant): causal per-tick order (solve at start-of-tick SOC), explicit demanded-power vs max-deliverable-power collapse gate, bracketed warning/cutoff events, latch-on-crossing warnings.

3. run_scenario converts powertrain fail-closed refusals into a named battery_voltage_collapse critical event (no invented post-failure thrust or state), records per-component verdicts (FAIL / NO_MODELED_LIMIT_BREACHED / NOT_SIMULATED) in ScenarioResult, and run_flight surfaces them.

4. Causality guard tests: perturbing the load after t_k leaves state and telemetry bit-identical up to and including t_k; equality and tick-edge bracketing; declared thresholds used verbatim from the component spec (no hardcoded tuning).

5. SIT delta: scripts/benchmark_sit_causal_repair.py re-runs the frozen calibration (cycles 1-50 only), applies the declared knee-anchor extension (component-table tail shape joined to the fitted curve; zero held-out tuning), evaluates replay + forecast with battery.py's canonical causal solver, and commits docs/campaigns/m21_sit_causal_repair_delta.json with the exact before-vs-after numbers. Frozen M21 artifacts untouched; the 4 stale strict-xfail markers in test_p0a_005.py are reconciled.

tasks.title: Verify battery replay versus prospective endurance behavior
tasks.acceptance: Separate measured-current replay from forecast demand; unchanged source rows are scored per run; cutoff misses/false alarms, endpoint error, charge/energy balances and timestep convergence are reported against frozen criteria. New physical acceptance stays open.
todos: 1. Split the two scoring modes: measured-current replay (current is source data) and forecast demand (current is model output); never mix them in one score.
2. Score every unchanged source row: cutoff misses/false alarms, endpoint SOC/error, charge/energy balances.
3. Add timestep-convergence cases for the replay and forecast paths and record the convergence table.
4. Document per-run results and exclusions in docs/acceptance/P0A-007.md.

tasks.title: Diagnose the UIUC signed-thrust disagreement
tasks.acceptance: Reproduce the signed CT case with source hashes; inspect axes, advance ratio, RPM, units, power definition and near-zero measurement resolution. Record evidence for the cause; do not assume a sign flip is correct.
todos: 1. Reproduce the signed-CT disagreement case with original source hashes and the exact pinned rows (no repaired data).

2. Inspect, one at a time and recorded: coordinate axes/normal conventions, advance-ratio handling, RPM units, thrust/power sign definitions, and the near-zero measurement resolution of the source instrument.
3. Write the evidence-backed cause (or the shortlist with the discriminating experiment) into docs/acceptance/P0A-008.md.
4. Change no model behavior in this task — diagnosis only.

tasks.title: Correct and verify the supported signed aerodynamic regime
tasks.acceptance: Analytical frame/force checks pass, source sign is preserved, extrapolation is refused or labeled, and all DEVELOPMENT sweep residuals/exclusions are published. M24 acceptance uses predeclared sign-resolution and uncertainty rules.
todos: 1. Implement the corrected supported signed-thrust/signed-speed regime with explicit analytic frame/force checks (sign preservation end to end).
2. Refuse or explicitly label any extrapolation outside the supported signed regime.
3. Publish all DEVELOPMENT sweep residuals and exclusions; M24 acceptance uses only the supported envelope.
4. Re-run the P0A-008 diagnosis against the corrected model and record the agreement.

tasks.title: Reproduce M25 misses and healthy-flight false alarms
tasks.acceptance: Reproduce UAV-FD rotor-order and ESC-power decisions per whole recording; preserve exclusions, labels and thresholds; identify missed classes and false alarms without using labels as detector inputs.
todos: 1. Reproduce the M25 decisions per WHOLE recording: rotor-order classes and ESC-power anomalies with the frozen thresholds.
2. Preserve all source exclusions and labels exactly; no label may leak into features.
3. Tabulate missed classes and false alarms per recording and identify the systematic causes.
4. Freeze the failure reproduction before any detector change (fixes are P0A-011).

tasks.title: Correct fault detection without data leakage
tasks.acceptance: Detection, no-alert and INCONCLUSIVE are explicit; whole-flight class/deadline/false-alarm regression cases pass; training and evaluation data remain grouped and disjoint; confirmatory performance is not inferred from development tuning.
todos: 1. Make DETECT / NO-ALERT / INCONCLUSIVE explicit outcomes of the detector contract (an alert must name its class and deadline).
2. Correct the detection logic with grouped, disjoint training/evaluation recordings — no whole-recording leakage in either direction.
3. Add confirmation/hysteresis rules so single-sample false alarms cannot raise an alert.
4. Re-run the P0A-010 reproduction and record the per-class improvements and remaining misses.

tasks.title: Propagate per-rotor electrical and supported actuator failures
tasks.acceptance: Unequal branch current, voltage, RPM, thermal or actuator limits produce FAIL on the affected component; supported loss/derating changes control authority; unknown post-failure behavior cannot create a successful trajectory.
todos: 1. Propagate per-branch electrical state: unequal branch current, voltage, RPM, thermal and actuator limits produce FAIL on the affected component.
2. Model only the supported loss/derating behaviors (loss of one branch, reduced-voltage derating); unknown post-failure behavior yields INCONCLUSIVE, never a synthesized recovery.
3. Assert control-authority changes after derating are reflected in attainable attitude/altitude responses.
4. Extend the acceptance tests for each supported failure class.

tasks.title: Freeze the QDrone collapse and command-provenance regression
tasks.acceptance: Reproduce original versus battery-aware MPC observations and conditional-model failure; identify the 14 V line as study-specific, and mark logged auxiliary/drive commands as measurements rather than independently predicted commands.
todos: 1. Reproduce the QDrone original-vs-battery-aware MPC observations and the conditional-model failure from the frozen source rows.
2. Identify and record the 14 V line as study-specific (not a pack property).
3. Mark logged auxiliary/drive commands as measured inputs (not free model outputs) in the registry and evidence.
4. Freeze the regression before any controller-coupling change (P0A-014).

tasks.title: Couple causal bus, propulsion and controller response
tasks.acceptance: Demand, voltage/current, attainable thrust, saturation and supported controller/actuator dynamics share one plant/clock; generated commands do not depend on future telemetry; known limit violations retain FAIL and unsupported collapse remains INCONCLUSIVE.
todos: 1. Couple demand, bus voltage/current, attainable thrust, saturation and the supported controller/actuator dynamics on ONE plant state and ONE declared clock.
2. Prove no generated command depends on future telemetry (causality test over reordered/stepped clocks).
3. Cover the known limit interactions: bus sag -> attainable thrust -> saturation -> controller response, with boundary brackets.
4. Extend tests/acceptance/test_p0a_014.py for each coupling edge and the shared-clock guarantee.

tasks.title: Verify the corrected multirotor numerical model
tasks.acceptance: Analytic force/torque, energy/charge checks, quaternion/coordinate round trips, timestep convergence, deterministic seeded reruns and failure-boundary regressions pass with declared numerical tolerances.
todos: 1. Verify analytic force/torque identities for the corrected plant (sum of rotor contributions vs plant output).
2. Verify energy and charge balances over closed integrations (consumed charge == integral of current within declared numerical tolerance).
3. Verify quaternion/coordinate round trips (body<->world, wxyz convention) for randomized attitudes.
4. Add timestep-convergence and deterministic seeded-rerun cases; cover the failure-boundary regressions from P0A-012.
5. Publish the declared numerical tolerances in docs/acceptance/P0A-015.md.

tasks.title: Make component sources and parameter uncertainty explicit
tasks.acceptance: Battery/motor/ESC/wiring/material/sensor records carry units, identity, source, limits and parameter-level evidence; unsourced typical values and assumed uncertainty bands display UNVERIFIED_ESTIMATE; missing required limits refuse acceptance.
todos: 1. Extend the component registry records: units, physical identity, source citation, operating limits and parameter-level evidence links for battery/motor/ESC/wiring/material/sensor records.
2. Mark every unsourced typical value and assumed uncertainty band UNVERIFIED_ESTIMATE and surface that flag in the UI/exports.
3. Refuse mass-property computation when a required density/source is missing (fail closed).
4. Add acceptance tests asserting each record carries the mandated fields.

tasks.title: Deliver the standalone desktop project workflow
tasks.acceptance: Normal Godot UI creates/imports/opens/saves/versions/reopens a supported project without an HTTP server; corrupt/missing assets and incompatible versions are handled; recovery preserves the last valid project.
todos: 1. Implement the normal Godot UI workflow: create, import, open, save, version and reopen a supported project entirely through the local worker (no HTTP server).
2. Handle corrupt/missing assets and incompatible project versions with explicit recovery or refusal paths.
3. Preserve project numeric identity through desktop round trips (existing JSON-authoritative tests stay green).
4. Add acceptance tests driving the worker contract from the UI entry points.

tasks.title: Build supported multirotor geometry through the 3D editor
tasks.acceptance: Normal UI edits supported exact body/blade geometry, transforms and dimensions with constraints, undo/redo and visible model support. Exact solids and engineering inputs remain authoritative across save/reopen; no placement-only screen is labeled full CAD.
todos: 1. Implement supported exact body/blade geometry editing in the 3D editor: transforms, dimensions and constraints through the normal UI.
2. Add undo/redo with visible model support (display LOD must never alter the authored engineering geometry).
3. Keep exact solids and engineering inputs authoritative in the saved project (worker-computed, UI-rendered).
4. Add acceptance tests for the edit -> save -> reload -> exact-geometry identity.

tasks.title: Connect component layout, materials, BOM and mass properties
tasks.acceptance: Supported arbitrary rotor counts/layouts and component selection update mass, CoG, inertia, powertrain and BOM; independent analytic geometry cases pass; missing density refuses mass and flight acceptance.
todos: 1. Wire supported arbitrary rotor counts/layouts and component selection from the editor into the worker mass-property assembly.
2. Update mass, CoG, inertia, powertrain and BOM through the authoritative assembly; render in the UI from the same numbers.
3. Add independent analytic geometry cases (known layouts -> known CoG/inertia).
4. Refuse mass-property computation on missing density/source (fail closed) and surface the refusal in the UI.

tasks.title: Integrate geometry clearance and supported load checks
tasks.acceptance: Rotor/obstacle/assembly clearance and datum transforms are checked from engineering geometry, including revision changes; LOD cannot change physics/clearance; screens retain analytical versus physically qualified status.
todos: 1. Implement rotor/obstacle/assembly clearance and datum-transform checks from the exact CAD geometry through the native/OCCT core.
2. Guarantee revision changes re-run the clearance checks; display LOD cannot change physics or clearance results.
3. Keep analytic screening results visible in the UI alongside the exact checks.
4. Add acceptance tests with known-overlap and known-clear fixtures through the real worker.

tasks.title: Author a repeatable engineering test ground
tasks.acceptance: Normal UI saves terrain, obstacles, landing/contact surfaces, wind vector, temperature, pressure and humidity with units/origin. Unsupported atmospheric/contact mechanisms are refused or unvalidated, not implemented by a visual shader.
todos: 1. Implement the engineering test-ground authoring UI: terrain, obstacles, landing/contact surfaces, wind vector, temperature, pressure and humidity with units and declared origin.
2. Refuse unsupported atmospheric/contact mechanisms explicitly (fail closed with the reason).
3. Serialize the authored ground with the project and verify save/reload identity.
4. Add acceptance tests for authoring, serialization and refusal paths.

tasks.title: Author missions, controls, clocks and experiment seeds
tasks.acceptance: Takeoff/climb/hover/descent/landing, manual commands and disturbances serialize commands, timings, controller/sensor settings and seeds; replay reproduces the frozen experiment independently of render cadence.
todos: 1. Implement mission authoring: takeoff/climb/hover/descent/landing phases, manual commands and disturbances with serialized commands and timings.
2. Serialize controller/sensor settings and experiment seeds with the mission (replay reproduces the frozen experiment identically).
3. Add acceptance tests: authored mission -> replay -> identical telemetry under the declared seed.

tasks.title: Run the supported design in the authoritative desktop simulation
tasks.acceptance: A normal geometry/component/environment/mission edit changes the applicable simulated response; one double-precision integrator drives playback; pause/step/run/cancel/failure states and model limits are visible end to end.
todos: 1. Run the supported design through the authoritative desktop simulation: a normal geometry/component/environment/mission edit must change the applicable simulated response.
2. Drive playback from ONE double-precision integrator (no parallel approximate integrators).
3. Implement pause/step/run/cancel and failure-state handling with worker supervision.
4. Add acceptance tests for edit->response causality and the playback state machine.

tasks.title: Inspect telemetry, evidence and reproducible result comparisons
tasks.acceptance: UI compares frozen runs and source measurements with units, frames, source/model hashes, operating envelope, exclusions and uncertainty; exported results distinguish calculated, measured and synthetic channels.
todos: 1. Implement frozen-run vs source-measurement comparison in the UI: units, frames, source/model hashes, operating envelope, exclusions and uncertainty.
2. Distinguish calculated, measured and interpolated values in every exported result.
3. Add acceptance tests for the comparison pipeline with a frozen run and a pinned source measurement.

tasks.title: Expose numerical fidelity and bounded execution
tasks.acceptance: Requested/effective timestep, backend, solver rates, numerical error and runtime budgets are recorded; interactive/offline runs of the same supported case agree within declared tolerance; cancellation and resource refusal preserve projects.
todos: 1. Record requested vs effective timestep, backend, solver rates, numerical error and runtime budgets with every run.
2. Prove interactive and offline runs of the same supported case agree within the declared tolerance (desktop worker vs headless integration).
3. Expose the fidelity/budget panel in the UI from the recorded numbers (not free text).
4. Add acceptance tests for the agreement bound and the recorded budgets.

tasks.title: Register component and multirotor validation protocols
tasks.acceptance: Freeze model/controller/geometry versions, channels, instrument/clock uncertainties, calibration groups, held-out whole experiments, stopping rules and M21–M27 tolerances before confirmatory reveal; qualified review is required for acceptance.
todos: 1. Freeze and register the validation protocols: model/controller/geometry versions, channels, instrument/clock uncertainties, calibration groups, held-out whole experiments, stopping rules and the M21–M27 tolerance bindings.
2. Refuse protocol registration with missing calibration groups or held-out definitions (fail closed).
3. Add acceptance tests asserting the frozen protocol records satisfy the registry contract.

tasks.title: Acquire and seal matching independent component experiments
tasks.acceptance: Custodian supplies legally usable exact-hardware/configuration battery, propulsion and sensor/controller measurements with original hashes, calibration and environmental records; previously inspected data cannot be relabeled blind.
todos: 1. CUSTODIAN (requires real external receipts): obtain legally usable exact-hardware/configuration battery, propulsion and sensor/controller measurements with original file hashes.
2. Record calibration groups, environmental conditions, instrument identity and clock bases per campaign; preserve source bytes unmodified.
3. Register each campaign in data/research/registry.json and reconcile; mark DEVELOPMENT/holdout partition per the prospective policy.
4. No acceptance tests exist by design — the custodian receipts ARE the evidence; the registry reconciliation is the machine check.

tasks.title: Validate battery, propulsion and controller component envelopes
tasks.acceptance: Each independent component experiment meets applicable M21–M23 frozen error, limit and uncertainty criteria; high-C/endpoints, transient torque/current/RPM and sensor/actuator timing are covered or explicitly outside the accepted envelope.
todos: 1. Score each independent component experiment (P0A-027 receipts) against the frozen M21–M23 error, limit and uncertainty criteria.
2. Cover high-C discharge endpoints, transient torque/current/RPM and sensor/actuator timing per the frozen protocol.
3. Publish per-campaign results; a criterion miss is FAILED VALIDATION, recorded — never re-banded after the fact.
4. Update the component evidence records with the measured residuals.

tasks.title: Freeze end-to-end multirotor flight predictions
tasks.acceptance: Freeze predictions, installed hardware, mission commands, payload, atmosphere, source custody and joint uncertainty construction before independent complete flights are revealed; no fitted time/trajectory alignment.
todos: 1. Freeze the end-to-end flight predictions BEFORE the flights are revealed: predictions, installed hardware, mission commands, payload, atmosphere, source custody and the joint uncertainty construction.
2. Cover the supported failure modes in the frozen predictions (loss/derating/saturation) per P0A-012.
3. Seal the frozen set with hashes in the registry; no post-hoc edits.
4. Add acceptance tests asserting the frozen set is complete and hash-bound.

tasks.title: Acquire sealed complete-flight and thermal/structural measurements
tasks.acceptance: Qualified custodian provides repeated hover/climb/descent/landing/control/disturbance/endurance trials plus applicable heat/load evidence; professional operational review is separate from software approval. Missing channels/calibration keep acceptance blocked.
todos: 1. CUSTODIAN (requires real external receipts): obtain repeated hover/climb/descent/landing/control/disturbance/endurance flight trials on the frozen installed hardware, plus applicable heat/load evidence.
2. Record telemetry channels, clocks, environmental conditions and custody per flight; keep the professional operational review separate from this acquisition.
3. Register the sealed flight campaigns with original hashes; DEVELOPMENT/holdout partition per policy.
4. No acceptance tests exist by design — the custodian receipts ARE the evidence.

tasks.title: Score full-aircraft agreement and relevant failure modes
tasks.acceptance: Per-flight trajectories, energy, heat/control response and failures meet the frozen M24–M26 applicable criteria; observed failures are retained, conditional replay is separate, and out-of-envelope operation is rejected.
todos: 1. Score per-flight trajectories, energy, heat/control response and the frozen failure-mode predictions against the sealed flights (P0A-030) using the frozen M24–M26 criteria.
2. Retain observed failures; separate conditional replay from the primary blind scores.
3. Publish per-flight agreement tables and all exclusions with reasons.

tasks.title: Calibrate joint whole-flight uncertainty and generalization
tasks.acceptance: M27 simultaneous whole-flight channel coverage and width limits pass by independent cohort, including numerical, measurement, parameter, environment and model-discrepancy uncertainty; sample coverage cannot substitute for flight coverage.
todos: 1. Calibrate the joint whole-flight uncertainty: simultaneous M27 channel coverage and width limits per independent cohort.
2. Include numerical, measurement, parameter, environment and model-discrepancy uncertainty terms explicitly (no single ±band collapse).
3. Publish the calibration result and any cohort that fails the width limits as FAILED VALIDATION.

tasks.title: Obtain independent multirotor credibility review
tasks.acceptance: Independent reviewer reproduces each intended-use acceptance from frozen inputs and source bytes, signs the scope/uncertainty/failure dossier and identifies all unsupported configurations.
todos: 1. REVIEWER (requires real external receipts): independently reproduce each intended-use acceptance from frozen inputs and original source bytes.
2. Sign the scope/uncertainty/failure dossier and identify every unsupported configuration, parameter or claim.
3. Record the review in docs/acceptance/P0A-033.md with the reviewer identity and the exact reproduced commands.

tasks.title: Deliver guided learning and saved invention experiments
tasks.acceptance: A learner can state a hypothesis, build/modify a supported drone, enter environment conditions, compare runs, inspect equations/assumptions and save a reproducible experiment through the desktop.
todos: 1. Implement the guided learning workflow: state a hypothesis, build/modify a supported drone, enter environment conditions, compare runs, inspect equations/assumptions and save a reproducible experiment — all through the normal UI.
2. Bind every saved experiment to the frozen inputs needed for exact replay.
3. Add acceptance tests for the save -> reopen -> reproduce identity.

tasks.title: Deliver bounded sweeps and design comparisons
tasks.acceptance: Supported parameter sweeps/optimization retain constraints, seeds, all infeasible/failed candidates and provenance; a repeat run reproduces the candidate/decision set, with no optimization-as-validation claim.
todos: 1. Expose bounded parameter sweeps and design comparisons through the UI on the supported optimization package: constraints, seeds and all infeasible/failed candidates retained.
2. Guarantee a repeat run reproduces the candidate/decision set exactly (seeded, hash-bound).
3. Surface optimization-frontier caveats (no invented optimum) in the results view.
4. Add acceptance tests for retention, reproduction and constraint handling.

tasks.title: Package and recover the standalone Windows application
tasks.acceptance: A clean-user installation launches desktop, shared services and required workers without a development HTTP server; dependencies/notices are included; failed install/update/project writes recover without losing valid user data.
todos: 1. Package the standalone Windows application: desktop app, local shared services and required workers, with dependencies and notices included and no development HTTP server.
2. Cover failed install/update/project-recovery paths with explicit user-visible handling.
3. Add acceptance tests executed against the packaged layout (not the dev checkout).

tasks.title: Protect regression, dependency security and compatibility
tasks.acceptance: All five exact-head CI jobs and unchanged npm/backend/CAD audits pass; project migration, incompatible assets, process ownership, budgets, interrupted work, save/recovery and headless/API compatibility have regression evidence.
todos: 1. Keep all five exact-head CI jobs and the unchanged npm/backend/CAD audits passing; bind results to the final PR head.
2. Cover project migration, incompatible assets, process ownership, budgets, interrupted work and save/recovery headless cases in acceptance tests.
3. No audit bypasses: npm audit --audit-level=moderate including development dependencies stays required.

tasks.title: Qualify baseline hardware behavior for supported cases
tasks.acceptance: Publish distinct 8 GB and 16 GB integrated-GPU installation/edit/run cases with CPU/GPU/OS/settings, >=30 FPS on the declared 200-part editing workload, frame-time/RAM data, <=5 s owned-worker cancellation, and correct low-memory refusal. Existing qualification is retained as one prior observation.
todos: 1. Publish distinct 8 GB and 16 GB integrated-GPU installation/edit/run cases with CPU/GPU/OS/settings and measured frame-time/RAM data.
2. Meet >=30 FPS on the declared 200-part editing workload and <=5 s project load on the recorded hardware.
3. Take real measurements on the declared machines — synthetic or CI-host numbers do not qualify.

tasks.title: Exit: usable multirotor software slice
tasks.acceptance: All preceding software tasks required for this slice pass normal-entry-point tests and independent numerical checks; scientific ledger lists accepted, failed and still-unvalidated uses. Publish the slice dossier; this exit enables 0B software, not physical acceptance.
todos: 1. Exit gate: verify every preceding software task required by this slice passes its normal-entry-point tests and independent numerical checks.
2. Publish the scientific ledger listing accepted, failed and still-unvalidated capabilities — software slice exit and physical exit remain different gates.
3. Record the exact commands and outputs in docs/acceptance/P0A-039.md.

tasks.title: Exit: physically accepted multirotor envelope
tasks.acceptance: Independent review accepts only the demonstrated matching multirotor envelope under M21–M27; unresolved physical gates remain open and no universal drone-equivalence claim is made.
todos: 1. Physical exit gate: assemble the P0A-033 signed dossier, the M21–M27 acceptance results and the open physical gates.
2. Accept only the demonstrated matching multirotor envelope under the frozen criteria; make no universal drone-equivalence claim and keep unresolved physical gates open.
3. Record the final envelope statement and open gates in docs/acceptance/P0A-040.md and the ledger.

tasks.title: Implement constrained sketch and feature-history editing
tasks.acceptance: Sketch dimensions/constraints, extrusion/revolve/boolean operations and dependency history are editable in the desktop; overconstraints, broken references, undo/redo and regeneration are tested.

tasks.title: Author exact wings, airfoils, blades and surfaces
tasks.acceptance: Supported custom sections, span/chord/twist and lofts create valid exact geometry with persistent provenance; analytic volume/mass fixtures and geometry tolerances pass; unsupported surfaces are explicit.

tasks.title: Assemble joints, placements and distributed mass
tasks.acceptance: Supported fixed joints/assemblies transform component masses and inertia to consistent datums; hierarchy edits, constraints and missing-material refusal survive project round trips.

tasks.title: Deliver versioned CAD import/export and unit-safe exchange
tasks.acceptance: Supported STEP/IGES and display mesh exchange round-trip declared units, solid identity and project references; invalid geometry is diagnosed, and STL/display meshes never silently replace authoritative exact geometry.

tasks.title: Implement geometry-to-aerodynamics loading
tasks.acceptance: Existing AeroSurface/AeroLoads contracts consume exact geometry, placements, station/polar hashes and moment datums; a geometric edit changes checked mass/inertia and appropriate aerodynamic loads; LOD independence and transform tests pass.

tasks.title: Deliver supported section/polar and wing aerodynamic models
tasks.acceptance: Signed lift/drag/moment and supported induced-flow/wing models pass analytic and numerical cases; Reynolds/Mach/angle support and uncertainty are enforced; missing polars and unsupported viscous/stall mechanisms cannot receive success.

tasks.title: Implement fixed-wing propulsion, trim and controls
tasks.acceptance: Control surfaces, throttle and supported trim/flight dynamics share one plant; thrust/energy/actuator limits and infeasible trim are explicit; analytic trim and perturbation checks pass.

tasks.title: Enforce stall, load, speed and control-authority envelopes
tasks.acceptance: Known operating/structural/actuator limits produce FAIL; stalls and post-limit motion are supported only where modeled, otherwise unvalidated/inconclusive; boundary regressions include conflicting or absent limits.

tasks.title: Run fixed-wing takeoff, cruise, maneuver and landing
tasks.acceptance: A supported fixed-wing design can be authored and flown from the desktop with consistent wind/contact/mission semantics; saved commands and results reproduce through the headless path.

tasks.title: Expose aerodynamic analysis adapters and convergence
tasks.acceptance: Versioned analysis jobs declare backend/fidelity, polar/mesh/boundary inputs, progress and cancellation; supported calculations publish timestep/discretization/iteration error, without claiming planned VLM/CFD execution is already delivered.

tasks.title: Verify fixed-wing numerical and geometry sensitivity
tasks.acceptance: Force/moment signs, geometry perturbations, trim, convergence, frame transforms and energy balances pass frozen verification cases; editor and headless results agree within declared numerical tolerance.

tasks.title: Register fixed-wing validation policy and frozen models
tasks.acceptance: Create reviewed family-specific criteria/uncertainty/measurement annexes before confirmatory reveal; do not transfer multirotor thresholds or validation without an explicit justified similarity argument.

tasks.title: Acquire sealed wing and fixed-wing component measurements
tasks.acceptance: Custodian provides independently measured matching section/wing/installed propulsion data with calibration, source rights, full conditions and whole-experiment grouping.

tasks.title: Validate supported wing/component loads
tasks.acceptance: Frozen held-out forces/moments/power meet registered error/uncertainty criteria across the intended attached-flow and any explicitly supported stall regimes; unsupported extrapolation remains unvalidated.

tasks.title: Acquire sealed complete fixed-wing flights
tasks.acceptance: Matching aircraft, control commands, firmware, payload, environment, independent motion/energy measurements and timing/calibration records cover the registered missions.

tasks.title: Validate full fixed-wing missions and joint uncertainty
tasks.acceptance: Registered per-flight agreement, failure behavior, whole-flight interval coverage/width and independent cohort generalization pass; failures and excluded channels are retained.

tasks.title: Obtain independent fixed-wing credibility review
tasks.acceptance: Reviewer reproduces the frozen results and signs the limited family-specific operating envelope; a multirotor qualification does not substitute.

tasks.title: Teach wing design and comparative experiments
tasks.acceptance: Desktop workflows compare span/chord/twist/airfoil/control choices with reproducible hypotheses, equations, assumptions, constraints and provenance; learning exercises disclose unvalidated regimes.

tasks.title: Qualify fixed-wing CAD application recovery and packaging
tasks.acceptance: Install/edit/exchange/run/save/reopen/cancel/update flows pass under declared hardware budgets; existing multirotor projects and current-head security checks remain green.

tasks.title: Complete fixed-wing experiment and source library
tasks.acceptance: Reference projects, environment/mission presets, model support and source-license/role records are versioned and reproducible; a sample project is not labeled physically accepted before its measurement gates pass.

tasks.title: Exit: fixed-wing software slice
tasks.acceptance: All fixed-wing software acceptance paths and preserved multirotor regressions pass; publish the supported model/domain matrix and unresolved physical requirements. Enables 0C software only.

tasks.title: Exit: physically accepted fixed-wing envelope
